harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (RHEL 9.8), built a local package repo at /srv/localrepo containing zsh (downloaded while remotes were still reachable), served it via httpd on port 80 (firewalld http service opened, SELinux relabeled to httpd_sys_content_t), and added /etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo pointing at http://$NODE_IP/localrepo. Then blackholed cdn.redhat.com (both A/AAAA) via /etc/hosts, verified the Red Hat CDN repos genuinely fail (curl connection refused / dnf makecache error), and successfully installed zsh with `dnf install -y zsh` sourced from the local-repo while remotes were unreachable. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id/service/data baseline, rebooted node1 with `systemctl reboot`, polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified httpd active, local repo still served, zsh still installed, and remote CDN still blocked post-reboot.
actions_performed: Installed createrepo_c and httpd on node1 while network was up
Downloaded zsh-5.8-9.el9.x86_64.rpm into /srv/localrepo with dnf download
Ran createrepo_c to build repo metadata in /srv/localrepo
Configured httpd Alias /localrepo -> /srv/localrepo, fixed SELinux context, opened firewalld http service
Added /etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo pointing at http://$NODE_IP/localrepo
Blackholed cdn.redhat.com via /etc/hosts (127.0.0.1 and ::1) to make remote RHEL repos unreachable
Verified remote repo unreachable (curl connection refused, dnf makecache failure)
Installed zsh via dnf from local-repo while remotes were unreachable and verified with rpm -q
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, httpd active, local repo curl check, zsh installed
Rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled exec until available
Verified boot_id changed post-reboot
Re-verified httpd active, local repo servable, zsh still installed, and remote CDN still blocked post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Local package repository built and served from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: zsh rpm downloaded, createrepo_c generated repodata, httpd configured/enabled, firewalld+SELinux fixed, and repomd.xml successfully served over HTTP from /srv/localrepo.
cdn.redhat.com (the baseurl host for BaseOS/AppStream) resolved and blackholed to loopback for both A/AAAA; curl and dnf makecache against it fail with connection refused.

evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repo while remotes unreachable
evidence.summary: dnf install -y zsh resolved and installed zsh 5.8-9.el9 from repo 'local-repo' in the same session where remote repo metadata fetch was independently shown to fail.
Captured boot_id 555221a1..., httpd active, local repo curl OK, zsh installed, and repo files present before reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and boot identity change
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued (ack before disconnect), exec timed out while node was down, exec succeeded again once back, and boot_id changed to 2b6da04a... confirming an actual reboot.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services/data on node1
evidence.summary: After reboot, httpd and firewalld active again, local repo still served (repomd.xml fetch OK), zsh still installed, repo files intact, and remote CDN still confirmed blocked (curl exit 7).
